paragraphs: ENKON sells Integral-LIS, a web-based application for the people who manage land and real estate holdings. It tracks leases, properties, land interests, contracts, permits and easements.

The system is modular, and the company says it now runs to more than thirty modules tied into GIS and mapping. Its in-house mapping software was formerly sold as EasyMap. One module follows the acquisition of easements along a transmission line corridor. Another tracks permits and licenses across an organization. It can be bought as SaaS or installed on the buyer's own servers.

Named markets include national, provincial and municipal governments. The company says it works with private and government organizations and crown corporations in North America, Africa and Europe. It was incorporated in 1997. Its first lease and agreement management system was built for the Lafarge Corporation. The company states that it is SOC 2 compliant.

quote.text: Today, Integral-LIS has over thirty powerful modules that are fully integrated with GIS and mapping technologies.
